name: network-check
description: Connectivity report: raw ICMP to 1.1.1.1, DNS + reachability of fedoraproject.org, and HTTPS reachability of two developer endpoints. Read-only.
author: builtin

steps.desc: Raw ICMP reachability (no DNS involved). Failure usually means no route or ICMP is filtered.
HTTPS fetch of the Fedora project page. Tolerated: a network may be up while this is blocked.
HTTPS reachability of the npm registry (developer endpoint). Tolerated like the other steps.
